result.summary: This session performed the fourteenth pre-admission trigger search over a scope explicitly disjoint from rounds seven through thirteen: numerical algebraic geometry and polynomial homotopy continuation methods. Six candidates were considered: C1 (witness-set computation and numerical irreducible decomposition), C2 (monodromy-based decomposition / monodromy breakup), C3 (parameter and coefficient-parameter homotopy continuation), C4 (numerical resultant/elimination via random linear slicing using pseudo-witness sets, arXiv:2601.04383), C5 (certification of numerical continuation output via Smale's alpha theory), and C6 (a genuinely finite-field-native probabilistic ideal-saturation technique, arXiv:1908.06020). Two structurally independent obstructions were established: a degree-floor obstruction (every witness-set-based method's path count is lower-bounded by the ambient variety's degree, Theta(B^3), matching ROUTE-08's own declared exponent exactly) affecting C1, C2, C3, and C4; and an exactness/field-mismatch obstruction, genuinely new to this hypothesis line though corroborated by two internal prior-art objects (KN-LIT-015, and the never-promoted heuristic candidate ECFG-P1593 for a different target), showing that complex/real numerical continuation, even under the strongest available certification technique (alpha theory), certifies exactness in characteristic zero only and never bridges to the frozen setting's F_p target. C6 escapes the field-mismatch obstruction entirely but computes only a scalar intersection count, not the required remainder transducer, failing on output type instead. Every candidate is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8, amended G2/G8 wording); none passes every item. The proof-search-map.yaml applies the four mandated cheap audits plus the lossy-projection test, all confirming the same structural verdicts by an independent route. The source-novelty-audit.yaml labels every source recalled, retrieved, kb, or internal (none recalled), confirms no overlap with the six screened pre-admission packets, the two P1553 mixed-radix packets' own reviews, or the seventh- through thirteenth-round trigger searches, and assigns novelty_status known, adaptation, or unverified per candidate with no claim exceeding retrieved or opened evidence.
